summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright, admin + read_only) of the carte grise OCR review feature. VERIFIED OK: (1) VD 594 862 Carte grise tab shows the 4 groups (cg-group-identification/vehicule/technique/administratif) with all persisted values (VIN WVWZZZ6RZEY063464, matricule 215.768.314, Limousine, 483 kg, 75 kg, Hygie-soins Sarl, Yverdon 22.05.2023, expertise 09.05.2023, AXA Assurances) and they survive reload; (2) clickable badge on the document line opens extraction-review-dialog with 24 fields, correct Correspondance states and VIN in Conflit (OCR WWWZZZ... vs corrected WVWZZZ...); (3) FULL 'Analyser' flow on VD 602 548: drag-drop upload of /app/test_reports/594862.jpeg -> line appears without badge with doc-analyze-{id} -> click -> 'Analyse en cours...' state (analyze button removed, no double click possible) -> real LLM analysis ~40s -> toast 'Analyse terminee - 24 champ(s) detecte(s)' -> review dialog auto-opens with current vs detected values, confidence badges, checkboxes and correction inputs, 9 COMPLETER fields pre-checked, all Conflit fields (incl. VIN) unchecked by default; (4) Fermer without confirming keeps the document with 'Analyse - 24 champs' badge and the review reopens identically; (5) confirming only 4 safe fields (numero_matricule, carrosserie, charge_utile, detenteur) applied exactly those 4 (no leakage of Polo/blanc/AXA/Yverdon/VIN), persisted after reload, badge became 'Valide - 24 champs' and those fields now show 'Correspondance'; (6) read_only RBAC verified at API level (4/4 pytest pass: cross-tenant extraction 403/404, validate 403, vehicle create 403). BLOCKER FOUND: the 'Scan intelligent' dialog (ScanDocumentDialog) crashes with a white-screen ReferenceError 'StatusBadgeField is not defined' as soon as the review step renders, so the legacy scan flow (and therefore the 'fermer le scan conserve le document / toast Analyse conservee' scenario) is unusable in the UI. The document is however created and preserved server-side (extraction_status=done, 24 fields) and can be reviewed/validated afterwards via the document line badge.

minor.issue: Re-analysing an already validated document resets extraction_status from 'validated' back to 'done' - the reference doc 594862.jpeg on VD 594 862 now shows badge 'Analyse' instead of 'Valide' although its fields were validated and persisted (all rows show Correspondance).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL REGRESSION: <StatusBadgeField status={f.status} /> is used but the component is neither defined nor imported -> React ReferenceError, full white-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay the moment the scan review step renders. ESLint confirms: 'StatusBadgeField' is not defined (react/jsx-no-undef) x2. Whole 'Scan intelligent - Permis de circulation' flow (cg-scan-import / cg-scan-camera) is broken after analysis; the close-without-delete behaviour and toast 'Analyse conservee' could not be observed because the component crashes before close.
read_only user sees write-action buttons '+ Vehicule' (add-vehicle-btn) and 'Synchroniser'; API correctly returns 403 but the buttons should be hidden/disabled as they are in DocFolderSection.
Unknown routes (e.g. /echeances instead of /timeline) render a blank page with only the nav bar - no 404 fallback route.

issues: No visual issues found: 4 groups well labelled, contrast fine, state badges (Conflit red / Correspondance green / Completer blue) readable, dialog scrolls correctly at 1920x1080.

action_items: URGENT: fix ScanDocumentDialog.jsx - define or import StatusBadgeField (used at lines 683 and 763); the scan review step white-screens. Re-run lint (react/jsx-no-undef) after the fix and re-test the scan close/keep-document scenario.
Preserve 'validated' extraction_status when a document is re-analysed (or expose a distinct label), so a validated document does not fall back to the 'Analyse' badge.
Hide '+ Vehicule' and 'Synchroniser' buttons for read_only users on the Vehicles page.

Optional: read_only tenant client-test-e2e has 0 vehicles - seed one vehicle + one analysed document there so the read-only review UI (no confirm button, 'lecture seule' note) can be verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ScanDocumentDialog.jsx references an undefined component (StatusBadgeField) - ESLint already flags it; add lint to the pre-commit/verify loop to stop this class of white-screen regression.
ScanDocumentDialog.jsx is ~800 lines and duplicates a large part of ExtractionReviewDialog's field/conflict rendering - extract a shared field-row component (DRY, and would have avoided this crash).
ExtractionReviewDialog/DocFolderSection code path is clean: readOnly guard, per-field state derivation and VIN lock are handled correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 scenarios pass; scan-dialog non-regression scenario fails)

The orphan scan PDF created by the crashed scan test (scan-20260901-131636.pdf) was deleted. VD 594 862 and its document were NOT modified.

rca_of_the_issue: White-screen on the scan review step: ScanDocumentDialog.jsx renders <StatusBadgeField status={f.status} /> at lines 683 and 763, but no such component exists in the file nor in any import (only components/StatusBadge.jsx exporting default StatusBadge). React throws ReferenceError during render of step 'review' -> CRA error overlay. Repro: vehicle -> Carte grise -> 'Importer un fichier' (cg-scan-import) -> pick an image -> 'Valider le recadrage' -> 'Analyser' -> after the LLM returns, the dialog crashes. Mitigation: define a local StatusBadgeField (or reuse the badge markup from ExtractionReviewDialog) and keep ESLint react/jsx-no-undef green.
